title: Does a small-shaft quenching furnace include the oil tank, washing and tempering equipment?
summary: Suneng's proposal dated 18 May 2026 for small metal shaft parts covers heating for oil quenching of materials including 40Cr, while listing washing and tempering equipment as buyer-supplied. The equipment schedule includes one oil tank, but the detailed structural description marks it as optional. The final scope must therefore define the tank and lift, oil-temperature recording, cooling water, and subsequent washing and tempering together. The heating-furnace name alone does not establish that the entire process is included.
